spots.chart_note: Blue = falling water; darker blue = fastest water in a Prime or Good window. Bottom strip shows night, twilight and daylight.
spots.rules_text: A Prime window has a moderate or strong falling tide whose fastest water overlaps first light or sunset, without strong wind, SSW–WSW wind, storms, cool water (under 60°) or choppy, murky water (wind averaging 13 mph or more over the window and the 12 h before); each drawback drops it one level. A weak fall, cold water (under 55°) or red tide nearby is always Marginal. Water temperature and red tide use the latest reading for every day. Fastest-water times are estimates.
